about.heading: About Meridian
about.intro: Meridian is a digital capital management ecosystem that gives participants structured access to professionally managed digital asset strategies — without needing to trade, analyze markets, or manage multiple platforms themselves.

treasury.title: Meridian Treasury
treasury.description: The Treasury holds Meridian's operating capital and deploys it across multiple digital asset markets and platforms.

infrastructure.title: Meridian Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Capital is distributed across exchanges, wallets, and P2P markets, where arbitrage and cross-market operations form the core of Meridian's strategy, supported by a controlled, limited use of AI-driven analysis.

participants.title: Meridian Participants
participants.description: Participants deposit supported digital assets and allocate their balance across available staking products.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.description: Deposit a supported digital asset, such as USDT (TRC20).

chooseProduct.title: Choose a Staking Product
chooseProduct.description: Select from the available staking options for your deposit.

dailyPerformance.title: Daily Performance Calculated
dailyPerformance.description: Meridian calculates the Treasury's actual daily performance.

proportionalResult.title: Proportional Result Credited
proportionalResult.description: Eligible staking positions receive a proportional result, minus Meridian's performance fee.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Once your staking period ends, your balance becomes eligible for withdrawal.

stakingProducts.heading: Staking Products
stakingProducts.intro: Meridian offers several staking options, each with its own period and performance fee structure, so participants can choose the term that fits them best.

flexible.title: Flexible
flexible.note: Full flexibility, with a higher performance fee.

oneDay.title: 1-Day
oneDay.note: A short commitment keeps the performance fee moderate.

oneWeek.title: 1-Week
oneWeek.note: A longer commitment lowers the performance fee further.

stakingProducts.clarifyingNote: These percentages represent Meridian's share of generated profit — they are not interest rates or promised returns.

bonusEcosystem.heading: Bonus Ecosystem
bonusEcosystem.intro: Participation, activity and contribution unlock additional benefits throughout the Meridian ecosystem.

registration.title: Registration Bonus
registration.description: A welcome bonus for new participants joining Meridian.

verification.title: Verification Bonus
verification.description: A bonus awarded after completing account verification.

firstDeposit.title: First Deposit Bonus
firstDeposit.description: A bonus on a participant's first deposit.

stakingBonuses.title: Staking Bonuses
stakingBonuses.description: Additional bonuses for daily, weekly and monthly staking activity.

bonusEcosystem.clarifyingNote: Bonus balances may have different conditions from deposited balances — for example, certain bonus funds may only be eligible for selected staking products. Bonus types and terms may evolve as the ecosystem develops.

wheel.heading: Meridian Daily Wheel
wheel.description: Eligible users can spin the Wheel once a day for a chance at rewards, bonuses and other ecosystem benefits.
wheel.note: Available rewards may evolve as the Meridian ecosystem grows.

pointsLevels.heading: Points & Levels
pointsLevels.intro: Meridian Points measure participation across the ecosystem, and your accumulated Points shape your Meridian Level — unlocking expanded ecosystem benefits as you progress.

levels.heading: Meridian Levels
levels.intro: As Points accumulate, participants progress through five Meridian Levels — from Bronze to Obsidian.

benefits.heading: Level Benefits
benefits.intro: Higher Meridian Levels can unlock a range of expanded ecosystem benefits, including:

pointsLevels.clarifyingNote: Exact requirements and benefits for each level may evolve as Meridian collects operational data and expands its ecosystem.

fund.heading: Treasury Performance
fund.demoData: Demo data for illustration only — historical performance does not guarantee future performance
fund.intro: Meridian calculates the Treasury's daily performance, which forms the basis for calculating results for eligible staking positions.

technology.heading: Technology
technology.intro: A few core technologies power Meridian Treasury operations.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: AI supports market analysis, risk monitoring and strategy optimization — assisting decision-making without removing financial risk.

arbitrage.title: Arbitrage
arbitrage.description: Meridian captures pricing inefficiencies through exchange arbitrage and cross-market operations.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.description: Meridian operates across major exchanges, wallets and P2P markets to diversify execution.

riskManagement.title: Risk Management
riskManagement.description: Meridian prioritizes lower-risk strategies like arbitrage before allocating limited capital to AI-assisted trading.

technology.closingNote: AI plays a controlled, supporting role — up to ~10% of eligible Treasury capital may be allocated to AI-assisted trading, with arbitrage and lower-risk strategies remaining Meridian's primary focus.

token.heading: Token & DAO
token.disclaimer: Tokenomics, conversion terms, governance structure and reward mechanisms are not yet finalized and are subject to change.
token.intro: A possible future token and governance layer, planned to connect with today's participation system.

futureToken.title: Future Meridian Token
futureToken.description: A future Meridian token may be introduced, potentially serving as an access and governance layer across the ecosystem — including DAO governance, ecosystem access, and access to future Meridian products.

tokenAllocation.title: Token Allocation
tokenAllocation.description: Distribution details are still being worked out.

earlyParticipantRewards.title: Early Participant Rewards
earlyParticipantRewards.description: Early participants may receive rewards — details pending.

dao.heading: Meridian DAO
dao.intro: Meridian's long-term vision includes progressively introducing decentralized governance in selected areas of the ecosystem.

communityGovernance.title: Community Governance
communityGovernance.description: DAO participants may eventually take part in decisions related to ecosystem development, selected products, and community initiatives.

professionalTreasuryManagement.title: Professional Treasury Management
professionalTreasuryManagement.description: Treasury management and security-sensitive decisions are expected to remain under professional management, not unrestricted public voting.

evolvingModel.title: Evolving Model
evolvingModel.description: The final governance model will be developed in later stages, as the ecosystem matures.

security.heading: Security Infrastructure
security.intro: Meridian does not rely on a single wallet or platform. Capital is distributed across multiple infrastructure types to reduce risk.

multisigAuthorization.title: Multisignature Authorization
multisigAuthorization.description: Critical wallet infrastructure may use multisignature authorization for added protection.

restrictedAccess.title: Restricted Access
restrictedAccess.description: Only authorized members of the operating structure have access to relevant Treasury infrastructure.

distributedRisk.title: Distributed Risk
distributedRisk.description: Distributing capital across multiple platforms reduces single-point-of-failure risk.

security.clarifyingNote: Exact wallet addresses, platform allocations and operational security architecture remain private where disclosure could create additional security risk.

ecosystem.heading: Meridian Ecosystem
ecosystem.intro: Meridian is developed as a multi-platform ecosystem, with each component playing a specific role in the overall experience.

app.title: Meridian App
app.description: Primary interface for balances, staking, bonuses, levels and account activity.

website.title: Meridian Website
website.description: Public information layer explaining Meridian, its ecosystem and ongoing development.

telegram.title: Meridian Telegram
telegram.description: Communication, community updates and ecosystem announcements.

bot.title: Meridian Bot
bot.description: Telegram-based interface expanding access to Meridian services and community functionality.

ecosystem.closingNote: Additional interfaces and products may be introduced as the ecosystem develops.

roadmap.heading: Roadmap
roadmap.intro: Meridian's development is built across five phases, from core Treasury infrastructure to a broader multi-product ecosystem.

whatIsMeridian.question: What is Meridian?
whatIsMeridian.answer: Meridian is an investment fund that operates across crypto markets, exchanges, and arbitrage strategies using AI technologies.

howToParticipate.question: How do I participate?
howToParticipate.answer: Participation is available by invitation. After gaining access, a deposit is made, and once confirmed, you receive participation in Meridian.

whatIsUnit.question: What is a Unit?
whatIsUnit.answer: A Unit is Meridian's calculation unit for participation, reflecting your share in the fund.

howWithdrawalWorks.question: How does withdrawal work?
howWithdrawalWorks.answer: Withdrawing funds is subject to a 30-day lock-up period.

doITradeMyself.question: Do I trade myself?
doITradeMyself.answer: No. The fund is managed entirely by the Meridian team — participants do not trade on their own.

isThereToken.question: Is there a token?
isThereToken.answer: Meridian is developing a future token ecosystem that is planned to connect with the current participation system over time. Final terms have not yet been confirmed.

areProfitsGuaranteed.question: Are profits guaranteed?
areProfitsGuaranteed.answer: No. Financial investments involve risk, and results are never guaranteed.

howToContact.question: How can I contact Meridian?
howToContact.answer: Through Meridian's Telegram channel (link in the footer).

risk.heading: Risk Disclosure
risk.intro: Participation in Meridian involves exposure to multiple categories of risk. This list is not exhaustive, and risk factors may evolve as the ecosystem develops.
risk.closing: Meridian does not guarantee a fixed return. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Participate only with capital you can afford to expose to financial risk.

howToVerify.question: How do I verify my Meridian account?
howToVerify.answer: Verification confirms your identity and unlocks full account access, including deposits and withdrawals. Submit the requested details in the Meridian App and our team will review them.

forgotPassword.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
forgotPassword.answer: Use the password reset option on the Log In page to receive a reset link by email. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or open a support ticket.

changeEmailUsername.question: Can I change my email address or Meridian username?
changeEmailUsername.answer: Open a support ticket with your request, and our team will help update your account details after verifying your identity.

accountAccessIssue.question: I can't access my account — what should I do?
accountAccessIssue.answer: Open a support ticket describing the issue (error message, device, browser) so our team can investigate and help restore access.

howToDeposit.question: How do I make a deposit?
howToDeposit.answer: Deposit a supported digital asset, such as USDT (TRC20), from the Meridian App to your account address.

depositNotShowing.question: My deposit isn't showing in my balance yet.
depositNotShowing.answer: Deposits are credited once the network confirms the transaction. If it hasn't appeared after the expected confirmation time, open a ticket with your transaction hash (TXID).

whichAssets.question: Which digital assets can I deposit?
whichAssets.answer: Meridian currently supports USDT (TRC20). Additional assets and deposit networks are planned as the ecosystem expands.

minimumDeposit.question: Is there a minimum deposit amount?
minimumDeposit.answer: Minimum deposit amounts can depend on the staking product you choose — check the Meridian App for current limits.

howWithdrawalWorks.question: How does withdrawal work?
howWithdrawalWorks.answer: Once your staking period ends, your balance becomes eligible for withdrawal, subject to a 30-day lock-up period.

withdrawalPending.question: My withdrawal request is still pending — how long does it take?
withdrawalPending.answer: Processing times can vary. If it's taking longer than expected, open a ticket with your request details so we can check its status.

withdrawalFees.question: Are there fees for withdrawing?
withdrawalFees.answer: Withdrawals may be subject to network fees. Meridian's performance fee applies only to generated profit, never to your deposited capital.

cancelWithdrawal.question: Can I cancel a withdrawal request?
cancelWithdrawal.answer: Contact Support as soon as possible after submitting a request — we can only cancel it if it hasn't been processed yet.

stakingProductsList.question: What staking products does Meridian offer?
stakingProductsList.answer: Flexible (no fixed period), 1-Day, 1-Week and 1-Month — a longer commitment lowers the performance fee.

performanceFeeMeaning.question: What is the performance fee?
performanceFeeMeaning.answer: It's Meridian's share of the profit generated on a position — never an interest rate or a promised return.

switchStakingProduct.question: Can I switch staking products?
switchStakingProduct.answer: You can start a new position in a different product from the Meridian App. Check your current position's terms before switching.

stakingLossRisk.question: Can I lose money while staking?
stakingLossRisk.answer: Financial investments involve risk, and results are never guaranteed. Review the full risk disclosure on the FAQ page before participating.

bonusTypes.question: What bonuses does Meridian offer?
bonusTypes.answer: Registration, verification, first deposit, referral, and staking bonuses — see the Bonus Ecosystem page for details.

howPointsEarned.question: How do I earn Meridian Points?
howPointsEarned.answer: Through staking, account activity, referrals, verification, deposits, ecosystem participation, and tasks & campaigns.

meridianLevels.question: What are Meridian Levels?
meridianLevels.answer: As your Points accumulate, you progress through five levels — from Bronze to Obsidian — unlocking expanded ecosystem benefits.

dailyWheel.question: What is the Meridian Daily Wheel?
dailyWheel.answer: Eligible users can spin the Wheel once a day for a chance at rewards, bonuses and other ecosystem benefits.

howReferralWorks.question: How does the referral system work?
howReferralWorks.answer: Share your referral link or code from the Meridian App. When someone joins using it, you can earn a referral bonus.

referralBonusAmount.question: How much can I earn from referrals?
referralBonusAmount.answer: Referral bonus amounts and terms may evolve as the ecosystem develops — check the Bonus Ecosystem page and the Meridian App for current details.

referralNotCredited.question: My referral bonus wasn't credited.
referralNotCredited.answer: Open a support ticket with your referral code and the referred account's details so our team can look into it.

multipleReferrals.question: Is there a limit to how many people I can refer?
multipleReferrals.answer: There's no fixed limit today — you can share your referral link with as many people as you'd like.

whatIsFund.question: What is the Meridian Treasury?
whatIsFund.answer: Meridian's Treasury holds operating capital and deploys it across digital asset markets. Its daily performance forms the basis for results on eligible staking positions.

howPerformanceCalculated.question: How is Treasury performance calculated?
howPerformanceCalculated.answer: Meridian calculates the Treasury's actual daily performance, and eligible staking positions receive a proportional result, minus Meridian's performance fee.

pastPerformanceGuarantee.question: Does past performance guarantee future results?
pastPerformanceGuarantee.answer: No. Past performance never guarantees future performance, and all figures remain subject to market risk.

fundTransparency.question: Where can I see the Treasury's performance?
fundTransparency.answer: Visit the Treasury Performance page for the latest performance chart (demo data shown until live reporting launches).

appNotLoading.question: The Meridian App or website isn't loading — what should I do?
appNotLoading.answer: Try refreshing the page, clearing your browser cache, or checking your connection. If the problem continues, open a ticket with screenshots and your device/browser details.

loginError.question: I'm getting an error when trying to log in.
loginError.answer: Double-check your email and password, then try resetting your password. If the error persists, open a ticket with the exact error message.

transactionStuck.question: A transaction appears stuck or unconfirmed.
transactionStuck.answer: Open a ticket with the transaction hash (TXID) and network used so our team can investigate.

reportBug.question: How do I report a bug?
reportBug.answer: Open a support ticket under Technical Problems with steps to reproduce the issue and a screenshot, if possible.

accountSecurityTips.question: How do I keep my account secure?
accountSecurityTips.answer: Use a strong, unique password, never share your password or verification codes, and always confirm you're on Meridian's official site or app before entering credentials.

neverAskCredentials.question: Would Meridian ever ask for my password or seed phrase?
neverAskCredentials.answer: No. Meridian staff will never ask for your password, private key or seed phrase — not by email, in a support ticket, or anywhere else.

suspiciousActivity.question: I noticed suspicious activity on my account — what should I do?
suspiciousActivity.answer: Change your password immediately and open a support ticket under Security so our team can investigate.

walletSecurityInfra.question: How does Meridian secure Treasury funds?
walletSecurityInfra.answer: Capital is distributed across multiple infrastructure types — exchanges, wallets and P2P platforms — with restricted, access-controlled infrastructure to reduce single-point-of-failure risk.

contactMethods.question: What are the ways I can contact Meridian?
contactMethods.answer: Ask the AI Assistant for quick answers, open a support ticket for tracked help, or join Meridian's Telegram for community updates.

languageSupport.question: What languages are supported?
languageSupport.answer: The Meridian website and support are available in English, Armenian and Russian.

futureFeatures.question: What's coming next for Meridian?
futureFeatures.answer: Check the Roadmap page for planned phases, from infrastructure and launch to expansion, Web3 and ecosystem growth.

generalOther.question: My question isn't listed here — what should I do?
generalOther.answer: Ask the AI Assistant, or open a support ticket under "Other" and our team will help.
